CWP.dataset is an R package designed for analyzing and comparing
fisheries datasets which are compliant with the CWP standards.

It includes functions for: ✔ Data harmonization and structuring ✔
Spatiotemporal analyses ✔ Conversion between different measurement units
(e.g., tons ↔︎ numbers) ✔ Comparing nominal and georeferenced datasets

## Installation

You can install the development version of CWP.dataset from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("bastienird/CWP.dataset")
```

## Documentation

Full documentation website on:
<https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bar_plot_default()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/bar_plot_default.md)
  : Create Bar Plots from Measurement Data

- [`build_book()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/build_book.md)
  : Build a bookdown project in isolated sessions

- [`calculate_rf_to_reach_final()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/calculate_rf_to_reach_final.md)
  : Calculate Raising Factors for Conversion to Nominal Data

- [`cat_title()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/cat_title.md)
  : Create a Title with Optional Child Header

- [`combined_summary_histogram_function()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/combined_summary_histogram_function.md)
  : Create a Summary Histogram of Measurement Units by Dataset

- [`compare_dimension_differences()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/compare_dimension_differences.md)
  : Calculate and Visualize Differences for Each Dimension

- [`compare_georef_nominal()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/compare_georef_nominal.md)
  : Compare Georef and Nominal Data

- [`compare_nominal_georef_corrected()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/compare_nominal_georef_corrected.md)
  : Compare Nominal and Georeferenced Data

- [`compare_strata_differences()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/compare_strata_differences.md)
  : Calculate and Compare Strata Differences

- [`compare_temporal_differences()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/compare_temporal_differences.md)
  : Calculate and Visualize Temporal Data Differences

- [`compnumberstratas()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/compnumberstratas.md)
  : Perform Strata Comparisons

- [`comprehensive_cwp_dataframe_analysis()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/comprehensive_cwp_dataframe_analysis.md)
  : Comprehensive Analysis of Initial and Final Datasets

- [`compute_summary_of_differences()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/compute_summary_of_differences.md)
  : Compute Summary of Differences

- [`create_dygraph_for_unit()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/create_dygraph_for_unit.md)
  : Create Interactive Dygraph for a Specific Unit and Measurement Type

- [`cwp_materialise_plot()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/cwp_materialise_plot.md)
  : Draw a deferred plot

- [`cwp_save_object()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/cwp_save_object.md)
  [`cwp_read_object()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/cwp_save_object.md)
  : Save and read R objects on disk

- [`download_codelists`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/download_codelists.md)
  : download_codelists

- [`enrich_dataset_if_needed()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/enrich_dataset_if_needed.md)
  : Enrich CWP Dataset

- [`filtering_function()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/filtering_function.md)
  : Filter Dataframe based on provided Parameters /Dimensions

- [`fonction_empreinte_spatiale()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/fonction_empreinte_spatiale.md)
  : Spatial Footprint Function

- [`fonction_groupement()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/fonction_groupement.md)
  : Group and Summarize Data

- [`function_geographic_identifier_renaming_and_not_standards_unit()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/function_geographic_identifier_renaming_and_not_standards_unit.md)
  : Rename Geographic Identifiers and Handle Standard Units

- [`function_multiple_comparison()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/function_multiple_comparison.md)
  : Perform Multiple Comparisons Between Datasets

- [`function_recap_each_step()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/function_recap_each_step.md)
  : Function to Record Step Details and Save Results

- [`generate_bookdown_yml()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/generate_bookdown_yml.md)
  :

  Generate a `_bookdown.yml` file dynamically

- [`generate_plot()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/generate_plot.md)
  : Documentation to do

- [`geographic_diff()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/geographic_diff.md)
  : Geographic Differences

- [`` `%notin%` ``](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/grapes-notin-grapes.md)
  :

  Negate `%in%` Operator

- [`groupping_differences()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/groupping_differences.md)
  : Groupping Differences

- [`isNullList()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/isNullList.md)
  : Check if All Elements in a List are NULL or Empty

- [`is_ggplot()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/is_ggplot.md)
  : Check if an Object is a ggplot

- [`is_null_or_not_exist()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/is_null_or_not_exist.md)
  : Check if Variable is NULL or Does Not Exist

- [`knitting_plots_subfigures()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/knitting_plots_subfigures.md)
  : Save Plots with Subfigures in a Knitr Environment

- [`last_path()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/last_path.md)
  : Extract Last Part of a File Path

- [`last_path_reduced()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/last_path_reduced.md)
  : Reduce Last Path for Georeferenced Datasets

- [`my_fun()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/my_fun.md)
  : my_fun Title

- [`other_dimension_analysis()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/other_dimension_analysis.md)
  : Calculate and Visualize Data Distribution for Other Dimensions

- [`other_dimension_analysis_dygraphs()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/other_dimension_analysis_dygraphs.md)
  : Calculate and Visualize Data Distribution for Various Dimensions
  Using dygraphs

- [`parameter_final_catch`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/parameter_final_catch.md)
  : Example subset of catch dataset (final)

- [`parameter_final_effort`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/parameter_final_effort.md)
  : Example subset of effort dataset (final)

- [`parameter_init_catch`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/parameter_init_catch.md)
  : Example subset of catch dataset (initial)

- [`parameter_init_effort`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/parameter_init_effort.md)
  : Example subset of effort dataset (initial)

- [`pie_chart_2_default()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/pie_chart_2_default.md)
  : Create Pie Charts from Data

- [`print(`*`<cwp_plot_spec>`*`)`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/print.cwp_plot_spec.md)
  : Print a deferred plot

- [`process_fisheries_data()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/process_fisheries_data.md)
  : Process and Plot Fisheries Data

- [`process_fisheries_effort_data()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/process_fisheries_effort_data.md)
  : Process and Plot Fisheries Data

- [`qflextable2()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/qflextable2.md)
  : Create and Save a Flextable

- [`read_data()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/read_data.md)
  : Read Data from Various File Types

- [`render_subfigures()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/render_subfigures.md)
  : Render Subfigures from a List of Plots

- [`save_image()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/save_image.md)
  : Save Plot as Image

- [`separate_chunks_and_text()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/separate_chunks_and_text.md)
  : Separate R Code Chunks and Text from an RMarkdown (.Rmd) File and
  Optionally Save Them

- [`spatial_coverage_analysis()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/spatial_coverage_analysis.md)
  : Calculate and Visualize Spatial Coverage

- [`strata_in_georef_but_not_in_nominal_report_launching()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/strata_in_georef_but_not_in_nominal_report_launching.md)
  : Launch Strata in Georef but not in Nominal Report

- [`summarising_invalid_data()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/summarising_invalid_data.md)
  : Summarizes invalid data in the provided dataset

- [`summarising_step()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/summarising_step.md)
  : Summarising_step

- [`tidying_GTA_data_for_comparison()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/tidying_GTA_data_for_comparison.md)
  : Tidy GTA Data for Comparison

- [`tidying_data()`](https://bastienird.github.io/CWP.dataset/reference/tidying_data.md)
